probe: sf-chat-message against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9 §12, gate 20); the behaviour simai/ui-chat's tests/browser/staff.test.mjs and sanitize.test.mjs hold for the message view: markup, footnotes and sources, waits and notices, rating and its reason, the task brief, the proposal card, a question's files, the template person, and the sanitizer's acceptance cases
